prompts.alice:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-ready transparent corner ornament for a dark PC-98 academic homepage, Alice Margatroid theme. Create one beautiful original 1990s Japanese computer game pixel-art decorative vignette, not a UI mockup or icon sheet. A blue-and-dusty-rose ribbon elegantly loops around a small finely dressed blonde doll and a wooden thread spool, with a few sewing threads and diamond-shaped stitches. It should feel like a quiet dollmaker's atelier, composed as ONE coherent small illustration, not a scatter of separate icons.
Composition: square canvas, artwork anchored tightly to the TOP-RIGHT corner, with the top and right edges intentionally cropped into the canvas edges. The largest object cluster occupies only the upper-right third; the left half and bottom half are predominantly truly transparent. A triangular field of tiny ordered Bayer/checkerboard dither pixels dissolves from dense at the upper-right edge to almost nothing toward the center and lower-left. The illustration's shadow planes also dissolve through ordered pixel dithering; NO smooth gradient or blur.
Style: hand-placed pixel art with strong readable silhouettes, solid shaded shapes, restrained 8-color palette, consistent coarse 128x128 logical pixel grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor to the output resolution. Muted steel blue #718fa8, midnight navy #293e51, dusty rose #b27e90, parchment #b9b4aa; a little pale highlight. Designed to sit on #141c27 and remain subdued. The art must read well at 200px wide. No people or character portrait, no lettering, no text, no frame, no border, no white background, no floor rectangle, no glow. Preserve genuine transparency, including holes between dithering pixels.
